experiment: Cross-system memory growth on 200 identical input records
dataset: cross_system_benchmark_200.jsonl (stratified sample, 52 positives, full date range)
key_findings: Four distinct growth behaviors: unbounded (MemTether), expansion (SimpleMem 1.185x), soft ceiling (Hindsight 0.50x), hard ceiling (mem0 0.10x)
Not a binary dichotomy but a spectrum: expand → preserve → soft-ceiling → hard-ceiling
mem0 and Hindsight both hit ceilings after phase 1: consolidation mechanisms saturate immediately
SimpleMem creates MORE memories than input (1.185x): semantic compression splits complex records
